name: hot-potato
description: Open-source inbound lead routing for GTM teams.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @hot-potato/router && npm run build --workspace @hot-potato/db && npm run build --workspace @hot-potato/integrations && npm run build --workspace @hot-potato/worker && npm run build --workspace @hot-potato/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @hot-potato/router && npm run test --workspace @hot-potato/integrations
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @hot-potato/router && npm run build --workspace @hot-potato/router && npm run typecheck --workspace @hot-potato/db && npm run build --workspace @hot-potato/db && npm run typecheck --workspace @hot-potato/integrations && npm run build --workspace @hot-potato/integrations && npm run typecheck --workspace @hot-potato/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @hot-potato/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run build --workspace @hot-potato/router && npm run build --workspace @hot-potato/db && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
